name: P-005 live: an unknown provider package and trigger pack install through the Cupboard route and appear on the generic Settings -> Integrations page (card with app registration and masked credentials; pack section with a provider-filled channel picker, saved and armed)
command: (launched by .papercusp/scratch/p005-fixtures/launch-p005.sh with VERIFY_TAURI_ISOLATED_DB=1, a private PAPERCUSP_HOME, VERIFY_TAURI_SOURCE_REF pinned and the acceptance inputs checked byte-identical to that ref; the fixture provider p005-fixture-chat and pack p005-fixture-pack are served from local fixture repos through a git url rewrite scoped to the isolated webview profile)
summary: verify-tauri-headless run 20261011T114603Z-172649 verdict=pass (passed=3 failed=0 blocked=0 skipped=0), isolated DB and private home, superproject 260c15f506, libs/papercusp 7c0fa73eec. A fixture provider the app has never heard of (p005-fixture-chat: daemon runtime, chat-message datatype, chat.channels capability, declared credentials and app registration) installed through POST /api/cupboard/install-plugin (409 review, then 200 on accept), as did a fixture trigger pack. Without an app update the page then showed a card for the provider, with a Create Fixture Chat app link, Copy definition, and docs link from the package's app registration; two masked, unconfigured credential fields; a format refusal on the page for a malformed bot token and a 422 from the server with nothing stored or echoed; saving valid values marked both configured; the credentials read-back carried no token or secret; and the card showed connected. The pack section rendered its channel input as a dropdown filled from the provider's chat.channels options (#general, #bugs), the choice C-bugs saved (PUT 200, status configured, nothing unmet), and Arm turned the pack on (Armed, 1 of 1 triggers on).

assertions.evidence: OK page rendered (Settings -> Integrations in the isolated desktop).

INSTALL_PACK status=200 ok:true name p005-fixture-pack, review.triggerPack {targetCount:1, bindingCount:1}.
